description: PostgreSQL 18 named composite creation, casts, storage, catalogs, attribute evolution, rename, and drop
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_named_composite_values CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_named_contact CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_renamed_contact CASCADE;
sql: CREATE TYPE type_matrix_named_contact AS (name VARCHAR(12), age INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_named_composite_values (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, contact type_matrix_named_contact);
SELECT contact, pg_typeof(contact), (contact).name AS name, (contact).age AS age, row_to_json(contact) FROM type_matrix_named_composite_values;

SELECT t.typtype, t.typcategory, t.typrelid = c.oid AS relation_matches, t.oid = c.reltype AS type_matches, t.typarray <> 0 AS has_array FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.typrelid WHERE t.typname = 'type_matrix_named_contact';
SELECT a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod), a.attndims FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = (SELECT typrelid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_named_contact') ORDER BY a.attnum;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_named_contact ADD ATTRIBUTE enabled BOOLEAN CASCADE;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_named_contact RENAME ATTRIBUTE name TO display_name CASCADE;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_named_contact DROP ATTRIBUTE enabled CASCADE;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_named_contact RENAME TO type_matrix_renamed_contact;
SELECT contact, pg_typeof(contact), row_to_json(contact) FROM type_matrix_named_composite_values;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_renamed_contact ALTER ATTRIBUTE age TYPE BIGINT CASCADE;
SELECT a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = (SELECT typrelid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_renamed_contact') ORDER BY a.attnum;
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN ('type_matrix_named_contact', 'type_matrix_renamed_contact');
